vscode.org.todo.previous: Emacs has no key of its own for it in an Org file: S-<left> on a headline (org.shift.left) cycles the state backward.
vscode.org.priority.up: Emacs has no key of its own for it in an Org file: S-<up> on a headline (org.shift.up) raises the priority.
vscode.org.priority.down: Emacs has no key of its own for it in an Org file: S-<down> on a headline (org.shift.down) lowers the priority.
vscode.org.timestamp.up: Emacs has no key of its own for it: S-<up> on a timestamp (org.shift.up) changes it.
vscode.org.timestamp.down: Emacs has no key of its own for it: S-<down> on a timestamp (org.shift.down) changes it.
vscode.org.table.insert.row.below: Emacs has no key for it: org-table-insert-row inserts below with a prefix argument.

helix.org.meta.up: Helix's code action moves the subtree and leaves the cursor where it was in the text; Emacs's cursor goes with the subtree, as it does when the command moves it (window/showDocument).
helix.org.meta.down: Helix's code action moves the subtree and leaves the cursor where it was in the text; Emacs's cursor goes with the subtree, as it does when the command moves it (window/showDocument).
helix.org.agenda.goto.other: Not among Helix's code actions: the other window is the editor's to pick (orgOtherWindow), which Helix does not know of; from the command line, the entry shows in the agenda's window, as with org.agenda.goto.
helix.org.agenda.follow: Not among Helix's code actions: follow mode shows the entry of the line the cursor goes to, and Helix tells a server no cursor moves; from the command line it turns on, and the entry shows in a split, which takes the focus.
helix.org.meta.return: The step adds below the cursor's line, as the keys of modal editors do (below); the code action adds where the cursor is, as M-RET does: from the command line, with below in its argument.

vim.org.agenda.habits: K in the agenda is the plugin's hover, as K is in Vim; the command runs from its menu (g?) or a mapping of the user's.

helix.agenda-columns: Helix shows no column view: it would draw over the agenda's lines, and the code actions leave it out (docs/helix.org).
helix.calendar: Helix has no date prompt: the calendar is a file the server writes again as the day moves, which Helix does not read again (it reloads no file changed on disk); a date is typed as a rename at the cursor (docs/keys/helix.org), so there are no date prompt keys to press.
helix.journal-calendar: Helix has no date prompt: the calendar is a file the server writes again as the day moves, which Helix does not read again (it reloads no file changed on disk), so there is no calendar for org-journal's keys.

zed.agenda-columns: Zed shows no column view: it would draw over the agenda's lines (docs/zed.org).
zed.calendar: Zed has no date prompt: a date is typed as a rename at the cursor (F2), as Zed has no box of its own for typed text (docs/keys/zed.org), so there are no date prompt keys to press.
zed.journal-calendar: Zed has no date prompt: a date is typed as a rename at the cursor (F2), as Zed has no box of its own for typed text (docs/keys/zed.org), so there is no calendar for org-journal's keys.

helix.agenda-entries 14: Helix does nothing with the files a result names to save, and the server cannot save a file: Save all Org files is not among its code actions, :write-all saves them (docs/keys/helix.org).
helix.agenda-entry-edits 21: Helix has no note buffer: the note is one line, typed as a rename at the cursor (docs/helix.org).
helix.agenda-entry-edits 22: Typed in the note buffer of step 21, which Helix does not have.
helix.agenda-entry-edits 23: Files the note of step 21, which Helix asks for as a rename.

vscode.agenda-navigation 18 cursor: q closes the agenda's tab, not its editor group as Emacs deletes the agenda's window: home.org, opened in that group since, stays in front of work.org.

helix.org-editing 5 messages: The code action is an edit that Helix applies itself, without running the command: nothing is said (Emacs says Priority of current item set to B).
helix.agenda-navigation 18 cursor: The agenda's buffer is closed (:buffer-close!, as the server's edits leave it changed), and Helix shows the buffer opened last, home.org, not the one the agenda was opened from: Helix has no window of the agenda's to delete.

zed.agenda-entry-edits 21: Zed has no note buffer: the note is one line, typed as a rename at the cursor (docs/zed.org).
zed.agenda-entry-edits 22: Typed in the note buffer of step 21, which Zed does not have.
zed.agenda-entry-edits 23: Files the note of step 21, which Zed asks for as a rename.
zed.agenda-entry-text 5: Zed gives a key no count, and C-u 2 E (two lines of entry text) is not E pressed twice, which turns entry text mode on and off.
zed.agenda-filters 7: Zed gives a key no count, and C-u C-u / is not / pressed four times.
zed.agenda-filters 9 messages: Step 7, which Zed cannot take, says Agenda filters: -home.
zed.agenda-navigation 18 cursor: q closes the agenda's tab, and Zed shows the tab beside it (home.org), not the buffer the agenda was opened from.
